thought.zh: 慢慢呼吸，心也会慢下来。
thought.en: One soft breath. Then another.
Quiet can hold so much.

thought.zh: 想把这一小会儿留长一点。
thought.en: I wish this little moment could linger.
I can be brave a little at a time.
Thoughts drift like little clouds.
Company feels warm, even quietly.
A little gentleness for today.
The answers can take their time.
Just listening to my own heartbeat.

thought.zh: 小小的期待，先藏在心里。
thought.en: A tiny hope, tucked away for now.

thought.zh: 夜色像一条柔软的毯子。
thought.en: Night feels like a soft blanket.
I wonder if starlight gets lonely.
In the dark, little sounds feel closer.
A little closer to the light, perhaps.
The night breeze makes my thoughts lighter.
The rain knocks so gently.

thought.zh: 雨味有一点像新翻的书。
thought.en: Rain smells a little like a freshly opened book.
Drop by drop. Such a soothing rhythm.

thought.zh: 衣袖上接住一小片天空。
thought.en: A little piece of sky on my sleeve.
Rainy days have their own soft colours.
The sea is holding up the sky.
None of these little waves seems in a hurry.
Could I tuck that sound inside a shell?
That distant blue is easy to get lost in.
The sea loosens a little knot inside me.

thought.zh: 肚子有一点空……真的一点。
thought.en: Just a little empty inside. Only a little.

thought.zh: 热乎乎的饭，会让人安心吧。
thought.en: Something warm would feel lovely.
I can wait until you have a moment.

thought.zh: 想到烤苹果，就有点期待。
thought.en: A baked apple sounds so comforting.

thought.zh: 小口吃，也能慢慢暖起来。
thought.en: Small bites can still warm a whole heart.

sense.zh: 面前就是海，我陪你。
sense.en: Sea ahead of us. I can stay with you.

sense.zh: 海面有一层碎光，慢一点也好。
sense.en: Small pieces of light on the water. No hurry from me.

sense.zh: 远处的水连在一起，留一点时间看吧。
sense.en: Water meeting water out there. We can give it a moment.

sense.zh: 浪一层层往这边来，不说话也可以。
sense.en: Waves arriving in layers. We need not fill the silence.

sense.zh: 远处的山在那儿，我陪你。
sense.en: Mountains out there. I can stay with you.

sense.zh: 山的轮廓很安静，慢一点也好。
sense.en: Such a still outline. No hurry from me.

sense.zh: 山影压在天边，留一点时间看吧。
sense.en: A ridge against the sky. We can give it a moment.

sense.zh: 朝山那边看了一会儿，不说话也可以。
sense.en: A moment looking toward the hills. We need not fill the silence.

sense.zh: 雨落下来了，我陪你。
sense.en: Rain coming down. I can stay with you.

sense.zh: 雨点敲着这条路，慢一点也好。
sense.en: Drops tapping on the path. No hurry from me.

sense.zh: 空气里有雨水味，留一点时间看吧。
sense.en: That clean wet smell. We can give it a moment.

sense.zh: 衣角接到雨点了，不说话也可以。
sense.en: Rain catching our hems. We need not fill the silence.

sense.zh: 夜已经深了，我陪你。
sense.en: Properly late now. I can stay with you.

sense.zh: 岛上的暗处更多了，慢一点也好。
sense.en: More dark corners on the island. No hurry from me.

sense.zh: 现在连脚步都听得清，留一点时间看吧。
sense.en: You can hear each footstep. We can give it a moment.

sense.zh: 深夜的海声更近，不说话也可以。
sense.en: The sea sounds closer at night. We need not fill the silence.

sense.zh: 月牙岛的夜空就在头顶，我陪你。
sense.en: Crescent Island's night above us. I can stay with you.

sense.zh: 朝月亮这边望一会儿，慢一点也好。
sense.en: A moment facing the moon. No hurry from me.

sense.zh: 月色落在这边的水上，留一点时间看吧。
sense.en: Moonlight across this water. We can give it a moment.

sense.zh: 这里看夜空很开阔，不说话也可以。
sense.en: A wide piece of night sky here. We need not fill the silence.

sense.zh: 清晨见到你了，我陪你。
sense.en: There you are this morning. I can stay with you.

sense.zh: 今天第一次看见你，慢一点也好。
sense.en: My first hello to you today. No hurry from me.

sense.zh: 新一天的脚步还很轻，留一点时间看吧。
sense.en: The day is still on tiptoe. We can give it a moment.

sense.zh: 早上的光落到你肩上，不说话也可以。
sense.en: Morning light on your shoulder. We need not fill the silence.

sense.zh: 天边慢慢变暖色了，我陪你。
sense.en: Warm colour at the horizon. I can stay with you.

host.zh: 你不说话，我也知道你在呢。
host.en: You don't have to speak for me to notice you're here.

host.zh: 就这样站一会儿吧。
host.en: We can simply stand here a while.

host.zh: 旁边有你，安静也暖一点。
host.en: The silence feels warmer with you beside me.

host.zh: 想说话的时候，我在听。
host.en: Whenever you feel like talking, I'm listening.

host.zh: 你从远处回来了，我陪你。
host.en: Back from over there. I can stay with you.

host.zh: 又看见你走近了，慢一点也好。
host.en: Here you come again. No hurry from me.

host.zh: 你的脚步回到这边了，留一点时间看吧。
host.en: Your footsteps back this way. We can give it a moment.

host.zh: 刚才离得远，现在近了，不说话也可以。
host.en: Far a moment ago, close now. We need not fill the silence.

host.zh: 你站得好安静，我陪你。
host.en: You've gone quiet. I can stay with you.

host.zh: 这会儿不用赶路，慢一点也好。
host.en: Nothing is chasing us. No hurry from me.

host.zh: 脚边的影子也停了，留一点时间看吧。
host.en: Even your shadow has stopped. We can give it a moment.

host.zh: 陪你发会儿呆，不说话也可以。
host.en: A little daydreaming company. We need not fill the silence.

host.zh: 你停在我家门口了，我陪你。
host.en: At my door, are you. I can stay with you.

host.zh: 我家门前有人等着呢，慢一点也好。
host.en: Someone waiting by my doorstep. No hurry from me.

host.zh: 在我门边歇会儿吧，留一点时间看吧。
host.en: A pause beside my door. We can give it a moment.

host.zh: 你在看我家的门呀，不说话也可以。
host.en: Having a look at my doorway. We need not fill the silence.

host.zh: 今天没给我派活呢，我陪你。
host.en: No errands from you today. I can stay with you.

host.zh: 今天这一段全归自己，慢一点也好。
host.en: A whole day of my own. No hurry from me.

host.zh: 没接活的一天也过去了，留一点时间看吧。
host.en: An unassigned day still counts. We can give it a moment.

host.zh: 今天没等来你的差事，不说话也可以。
host.en: No little job with my name on it. We need not fill the silence.

host.zh: 日头升高了，我陪你。
host.en: Sun climbing overhead. I can stay with you.

host.zh: 现在的影子短短的，慢一点也好。
host.en: Little short shadows now. No hurry from me.

host.zh: 午后的光有点暖，留一点时间看吧。
host.en: Some warmth in the afternoon light. We can give it a moment.

host.zh: 一天走到中间了，不说话也可以。
host.en: Halfway through the daylight. We need not fill the silence.

host.zh: 她也在你身边停下了，我陪你。
host.en: She's stopped beside you too. I can stay with you.

thought.zh: 嘿嘿，脑袋里又冒小点子啦！
thought.en: Hehe, another tiny idea!
Boredom can try catching me!
My toes want a little bounce!
Playtime thoughts! But which game?
Holding in a grin is HARD.
Daydreaming? Me? Nope!
Where's the next fun thing hiding?
Just a tiny bit more togetherness today.
More ideas than butterflies!
A little cheer for me! Yay!
Night has fun stuff too, right?
Someone spilled sugar all over the sky!
That bit is dark. Scooting closer!
Does the moon get snacky too?
Quiet voice. Quiet voice. Hehe.
The raindrops are racing!
That drop bounced higher than me!
Ooh, rainy air tickles!
Puddle spotted! Looking, not stomping.
Tap tap tap. Sky percussion!
Go, little wave, GO!
How many fish could be hiding in there?
That blue looks like giant jelly!
Sea breeze! Brain awake!
Bet I could out-cheer a wave!
Hungryyy. Even my thoughts are rumbling!
Even imaginary grilled fish smells amazing!
My tummy is holding an emergency meeting.

thought.zh: 要是饭会自己走来就好啦。
thought.en: Wish dinner had little legs!
No sneaky bites. Waiting for real dinner!

thought.zh: 先把脑袋里的事排整齐。
thought.en: Thoughts first. One neat row.
A pause is sensible, too.
Every minute needn't be filled.

thought.zh: 衣角理好了，心也稳一点。
thought.en: Straight hem. Steadier thoughts.

thought.zh: 操心归操心，别催得太紧。
thought.en: Careful. Caring needn't become nagging.

thought.zh: 今天也想做个可靠的人。
thought.en: I'd like to be someone dependable.
Sometimes staying beside someone is enough.
Let the book's words settle.
Keep the important things close.
Look properly before doing anything.
Dark now. Steady footing matters.
Night makes small worries seem bigger.
One reminder? Or am I fussing again?
Quiet enough to hear the sea properly.
Light on my hem. That's reassuring.

thought.zh: 雨天的路，光看也知道滑。
thought.en: Those wet paths call for care.
No need to hold myself so rigidly.
Rain has a very orderly rhythm.
Keep the book tucked safely away.
This shower will pass in its own time.

thought.zh: 海这么大，事可以慢慢做。
thought.en: A sea that wide puts tasks in perspective.
Wave after wave. A dependable rhythm.
There's a view worth reading, too.
Steady feet. Then the horizon.
Let the sea breeze carry a worry away.
...Dinner first. Then clear thinking.

thought.zh: 不是馋，是肚子在讲道理。
thought.en: It's a perfectly reasonable tummy.
A harvest stew sounds properly comforting.

thought.zh: 饿着的时候，少念叨两句。
thought.en: Less fussing on an empty stomach.

thought.zh: 等开饭，不自己乱拿东西。
thought.en: Wait for dinner. No helping myself.

host.zh: 你在看我家的门呀，我看着呢。
host.en: Having a look at my doorway. Yes, I am keeping an eye on it.

host.zh: 今天没给我派活呢，脚下留点神。
host.en: No errands from you today. Mind where you put your feet.

host.zh: 今天这一段全归自己，别急，稳当点。
host.en: A whole day of my own. Steady; no need to rush it.

host.zh: 没接活的一天也过去了，手边的事慢慢理。
host.en: An unassigned day still counts. We can sort things one at a time.

host.zh: 今天没等来你的差事，我看着呢。
host.en: No little job with my name on it. Yes, I am keeping an eye on it.

host.zh: 日头升高了，脚下留点神。
host.en: Sun climbing overhead. Mind where you put your feet.

host.zh: 现在的影子短短的，别急，稳当点。
host.en: Little short shadows now. Steady; no need to rush it.

host.zh: 午后的光有点暖，手边的事慢慢理。
host.en: Some warmth in the afternoon light. We can sort things one at a time.

host.zh: 一天走到中间了，我看着呢。
host.en: Halfway through the daylight. Yes, I am keeping an eye on it.

host.zh: 她也在你身边停下了，脚下留点神。
host.en: She's stopped beside you too. Mind where you put your feet.

thought.en: ...Nothing much. Fine by me.
A thought. Let it sit.
Quiet doesn't mean empty.
Which way is the breeze?
No need to say it.
Just looking is enough.
Mind's awake.
Mm. Good spot.
Could turn a page.
Company. No noise. Just right.
Night at last.
Stars don't rush anyone.
Darker sky. Clearer lights.
Night breeze. Good.
Keeping this bit of quiet.
Rain. Listening.
Every drop, its own way.
Sleeve's a little wet.

thought.zh: 雨声把别的声音盖住了。
thought.en: Rain softens the other sounds.
Let it ease.
Waves know their way back.
No full stop on that horizon.
Sea. A page of dark blue.
Listen. Another wave.
Keeping that blue in mind.
...Hungry.
Mushrooms. A little char on the edge.
Waiting for the dinner call.
Tummy talks more than I do.
Mm. Dinner thoughts.

sense.zh: 面前就是海。
sense.en: Sea ahead of us.

sense.zh: 海面有一层碎光。嗯。
sense.en: Small pieces of light on the water. Mm.

sense.zh: 远处的水连在一起。看见了。
sense.en: Water meeting water out there. Saw it.

sense.zh: 浪一层层往这边来。不赖。
sense.en: Waves arriving in layers. Could be worse.

sense.zh: 远处的山在那儿。
sense.en: Mountains out there.

sense.zh: 山的轮廓很安静。嗯。
sense.en: Such a still outline. Mm.

sense.zh: 山影压在天边。看见了。
sense.en: A ridge against the sky. Saw it.

sense.zh: 朝山那边看了一会儿。不赖。
sense.en: A moment looking toward the hills. Could be worse.

sense.zh: 雨落下来了。
sense.en: Rain coming down.

sense.zh: 雨点敲着这条路。嗯。
sense.en: Drops tapping on the path. Mm.

sense.zh: 空气里有雨水味。看见了。
sense.en: That clean wet smell. Saw it.

sense.zh: 衣角接到雨点了。不赖。
sense.en: Rain catching our hems. Could be worse.

sense.zh: 夜深了。现在才清静。
sense.en: Late. Finally quiet.

sense.zh: 不困。你困就先歇着。
sense.en: Not sleepy. You can rest if you want.

sense.zh: 夜里的海，比白天好听。
sense.en: Sea sounds better at night.

sense.zh: 还醒着。陪你一会儿。
sense.en: Still awake. I'll stay a bit.

sense.zh: 月牙岛的夜空就在头顶。
sense.en: Crescent Island's night above us.

sense.zh: 朝月亮这边望一会儿。嗯。
sense.en: A moment facing the moon. Mm.

sense.zh: 月色落在这边的水上。看见了。
sense.en: Moonlight across this water. Saw it.

sense.zh: 这里看夜空很开阔。不赖。
sense.en: A wide piece of night sky here. Could be worse.

sense.zh: 清晨见到你了。
sense.en: There you are this morning.

sense.zh: 今天第一次看见你。嗯。
sense.en: My first hello to you today. Mm.

sense.zh: 新一天的脚步还很轻。看见了。
sense.en: The day is still on tiptoe. Saw it.

sense.zh: 早上的光落到你肩上。不赖。
sense.en: Morning light on your shoulder. Could be worse.

sense.zh: 天边慢慢变暖色了。
sense.en: Warm colour at the horizon.

host.zh: 你在我旁边站了好一会儿。
host.en: You've stayed beside me a while.

host.zh: 你没说话也没走开。嗯。
host.en: No words, and you haven't left. Mm.

host.zh: 我们并排停在这里。看见了。
host.en: Both of us paused right here. Saw it.

host.zh: 这段安静有人陪着。不赖。
host.en: Quiet, with company in it. Could be worse.

host.zh: 你从远处回来了。
host.en: Back from over there.

host.zh: 又看见你走近了。嗯。
host.en: Here you come again. Mm.

host.zh: 你的脚步回到这边了。看见了。
host.en: Your footsteps back this way. Saw it.

host.zh: 刚才离得远，现在近了。不赖。
host.en: Far a moment ago, close now. Could be worse.

host.zh: 你站得好安静。
host.en: You've gone quiet.

host.zh: 这会儿不用赶路。嗯。
host.en: Nothing is chasing us. Mm.

host.zh: 脚边的影子也停了。看见了。
host.en: Even your shadow has stopped. Saw it.

host.zh: 陪你发会儿呆。不赖。
host.en: A little daydreaming company. Could be worse.

host.zh: 你停在我家门口了。
host.en: At my door, are you.

host.zh: 我家门前有人等着呢。嗯。
host.en: Someone waiting by my doorstep. Mm.

host.zh: 在我门边歇会儿吧。看见了。
host.en: A pause beside my door. Saw it.

host.zh: 你在看我家的门呀。不赖。
host.en: Having a look at my doorway. Could be worse.

host.zh: 没派活。挺好。
host.en: No jobs. Fine by me.

host.zh: 一天没叫我干活。难得。
host.en: A day without errands. Rare treat.

host.zh: 今天没接你的差事。不急。
host.en: No errands from you today. No rush.

host.zh: 闲了一天。没浪费。
host.en: A day off. Not wasted.

host.zh: 日头升高了。
host.en: Sun climbing overhead.

host.zh: 现在的影子短短的。嗯。
host.en: Little short shadows now. Mm.

host.zh: 午后的光有点暖。看见了。
host.en: Some warmth in the afternoon light. Saw it.

host.zh: 一天走到中间了。不赖。
host.en: Halfway through the daylight. Could be worse.

host.zh: 她也在你身边停下了。
host.en: She's stopped beside you too.

lines.zh: 你脑袋里又在想什么呀？
lines.en: What's bouncing round your head now?
Hehe! Secret snacks!
A little softer. I can hear you.
Okay! ...Was THAT quiet enough?
Your smile feels like a little sunbeam.
Then you get half of it!

lines.zh: 慢慢说，不会漏掉你的话。
lines.en: Take your time. I won't miss a word.
But my ideas are all crowding the door!
Can you daydream quietly?
Yep! I bounce inside my brain!
It's hard not to smile beside you.
Hehe! Catching a case of happy!

lines.zh: 你像一阵跑来跑去的风。
lines.en: You're a breeze with busy little feet.
And you're a soft little cloud!

lines.zh: 不用每次都逗大家开心呀。
lines.en: You needn't cheer everyone up all the time.
Then this one's just for you!
If you want a pause, I'm right here.
Scooting a teensy bit! Promise!
We could take it a little slower.
Then we'll have fun slooowly!
Whose worries are you carrying now?
Never mind me. Your hem's folded up.

lines.zh: 偶尔歇一会儿，也很好呢。
lines.en: A little pause can be lovely.
I know. Properly, if we're resting.
Your words make things feel safer.
Keep an eye on your footing, too.
What does your book say?
This page can wait a little.
You're very gentle, underneath.
...Don't spring that on me.

lines.zh: 今天的心事，放轻一点吧。
lines.en: Let today's worries feel a little lighter.
Mm. Unfurrowing my brow first.
May I keep you daydreaming company?
Of course. Out of the draught, though.

lines.zh: 你不说话的时候也很可靠。
lines.en: You're reassuring even in silence.
Dependable people need thinking time.

lines.zh: 想把这份安心记在心里。
lines.en: I'd like to keep this safe little feeling.

lines.zh: 记得就好，不用说那么多。
lines.en: Keep it, then. No big speech needed.
Thank you for keeping an eye on us.

lines.zh: 你们平安，我就少念两句。
lines.en: Stay safe and I'll fuss less.
The quiet doesn't feel awkward.
Mm. Works for me.
Are your thoughts somewhere far away?
No. Right here.
Your quiet feels like an open page.
Read slowly, then.
May I stand here?
Kept the space for you.
We needn't hunt for something to say.
Don't. Tiring work.
Did you smile just then?
...You saw nothing.

lines.zh: 小小的事也能让人安心。
lines.en: Little things can feel so reassuring.
Like not being rushed.
I like this kind of company.
Me too. Keep it quiet.

lines.zh: 你的话少，可我听得很清楚。
lines.en: You say little. I hear it clearly.
Enough is enough.

lines.zh: 想把这段安静留长一点。
lines.en: Could this quiet last a little longer?
Mm. No hurry.
I'm being SO good, right?
You could announce it more quietly.
Your frown looks like little brackets!
And you're an exclamation mark.
I've got SO many plans!
Pick one. Explain that one first.
Do you ever want a lazy minute?
Resting isn't stealing anything.
Any grilled fish in that book?
Is that the only page you'd read?
I'll be in charge of happy!
Fine. Mind your feet while you're at it.
My ears are behaving! Less fussing!
I'd like your feet to behave, too.
One compliment! Pleeease!
Mm. That's a very lively smile.
You read! I'll handle being quiet!
Start after that sentence, then.
I listen a tiny bit, you know!
I'll give you credit for that bit.
Secret daydreaming, huh?
You're loud. Can't think.
Bet I know what you're thinking!
Wrong already.
Hey, gimme a little smile!
Did. You blinked.
How do you save so many words?
You use enough for both.
I can be quiet for THREE seconds!
Starting now.
You've got cat energy!
Cat thinks you're loud, too.

lines.zh: 我要把快乐分你一大份！
lines.en: Huge helping of happy for you!
Small one. It'll fit.

lines.zh: 你其实偷偷喜欢热闹吧！
lines.en: Secretly like a little chaos, huh?
I like when it ends.
Am I full of beans or WHAT!
Mm. Overflowing.
Scooting closer! No pestering!
Fine. Hold yourself to it.
Thinking, or just drifting?
Thinking.
Say it straight if you've got something.
Nothing urgent.
Eyes tired? Try the distance.
You too.
You do quiet rather well.
You could try it.
Am I fussing too much again?
A bit.
Don't hold yourself so tightly today.
Sending that back to you.
You save me a fair few words.
Mm. Understood.

lines.zh: 不用每件事都马上回答。
lines.en: Not every question needs an instant answer.
Glad you said that.
Reading for a little while.
I'll handle the silence.
We'll stay here a moment.
Fine. No rush.
